world.title: Monsoon Ventures launches in Singapore with $900,000 to back South-east Asia agritech startups
world.description:
Beanstalk AgTech, an Australia-based agriculture advisory firm, launched Monsoon Ventures in Singapore on 11 August. The venture studio is backed by Enterprise Singapore and Rabo Foundation, the corporate foundation of Dutch bank Rabobank.
Monsoon Ventures received S$1.2 million in seed funding and will support agritech startups across Vietnam, Indonesia, Thailand, Malaysia, the Philippines and Singapore. The studio targets funding up to eight ventures within two years.
Over five years, Monsoon Ventures aims to build a portfolio of more than 30 scalable ventures across South-east Asia. The studio focuses on commercialising agritech solutions that improve farmer livelihoods, environmental outcomes and regional food security.
Beanstalk AgTech previously launched Drought Venture Studio in Australia in March 2024, which helped raise over A$22 million.
